# Subway Seat for WezTerm

Colors, cursor, selection, splits, copy mode, quick select and the tab bar. On Windows the folder is `%USERPROFILE%\.config\wezterm\colors`.

[WezTerm](https://wezterm.org) · [Previews and copy buttons](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/wezterm/)

## Files

| Flavor | File | Where it goes |
|---|---|---|
| Subway Seat | [`subway-seat.toml`](subway-seat.toml) | `~/.config/wezterm/colors/subway-seat.toml` |
| Subway Seat Tunnel | [`subway-seat-tunnel.toml`](subway-seat-tunnel.toml) | `~/.config/wezterm/colors/subway-seat-tunnel.toml` |
| Subway Seat Enamel | [`subway-seat-enamel.toml`](subway-seat-enamel.toml) | `~/.config/wezterm/colors/subway-seat-enamel.toml` |
| London Moquette | [`london-moquette.toml`](london-moquette.toml) | `~/.config/wezterm/colors/london-moquette.toml` |
| London Deep Level | [`london-deep-level.toml`](london-deep-level.toml) | `~/.config/wezterm/colors/london-deep-level.toml` |
| London Portland | [`london-portland.toml`](london-portland.toml) | `~/.config/wezterm/colors/london-portland.toml` |

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in ~/.config/wezterm/wezterm.lua:

```lua
config.color_scheme = 'Subway Seat'
-- the fancy tab bar's strip comes from window_frame, which a scheme file can't set
local colors = wezterm.color.load_scheme(wezterm.home_dir .. '/.config/wezterm/colors/subway-seat.toml')
config.window_frame = { active_titlebar_bg = colors.tab_bar.background, inactive_titlebar_bg = colors.tab_bar.background }
```

## Follow light and dark

In ~/.config/wezterm/wezterm.lua (WezTerm reloads it when the appearance changes):

```lua
local dark = not wezterm.gui or wezterm.gui.get_appearance():find('Dark')
local slug = dark and 'subway-seat' or 'subway-seat-enamel'
local colors, meta = wezterm.color.load_scheme(wezterm.home_dir .. '/.config/wezterm/colors/' .. slug .. '.toml')
config.color_scheme = meta.name
config.window_frame = { active_titlebar_bg = colors.tab_bar.background, inactive_titlebar_bg = colors.tab_bar.background }
```

## Uninstall

- Delete `~/.config/wezterm/colors/subway-seat.toml`.
- Delete `~/.config/wezterm/colors/subway-seat-tunnel.toml`.
- Delete `~/.config/wezterm/colors/subway-seat-enamel.toml`.
- Delete `~/.config/wezterm/colors/london-moquette.toml`.
- Delete `~/.config/wezterm/colors/london-deep-level.toml`.
- Delete `~/.config/wezterm/colors/london-portland.toml`.
- Remove the line you added to turn it on.

Generated by `build.py` from `palette.py` (v0.3.0). Edit the port in `ports/`, not these files.
